**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL, § 8).

Section 8.2–8.3 hits the preferred position on every material term: 12-month renewal periods (no multi-year auto-renewal), a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window, a 60-day Vendor reminder with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is late, and renewal uplift capped at the lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods. No redline proposed.
